title: Working with Children Check retrieval on Service NSW mobile app (holder) – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for retrieving a digital Working with Children Check (WWCC) and generating a scannable QR Code via the Service NSW mobile app.
intro: The Working with Children Check (‘WWCC’) retrieval provides a digital version of a WWCC, issued by the Office of the Children’s Guardian. The digital version can be used to generate a QR Code. The QR Code can be scanned by parents or carers, using their mobile phone, to verify the holder has a current WWCC. In these terms and conditions, this is referred to as the ‘QR Code verification process’.
who_can_apply: Hold a valid Working with Children Check (WWCC).
Have or be able to obtain a MyServiceNSW account and agree to its terms and conditions.
Link your MyServiceNSW account to WWCC.
what_you_need: A valid Working with Children Check (WWCC).
A working and sufficiently charged electronic device (phone) to generate and scan the QR Code.

faqs.q: What is the Working with Children Check (WWCC) retrieval process?
faqs.a: The WWCC retrieval provides a digital version of the WWCC, issued by the Office of the Children’s Guardian. This digital version can generate a QR Code that parents or carers can scan to verify the holder has a current WWCC.

faqs.q: What are the eligibility requirements for using the WWCC retrieval service?
faqs.a: You must have or be able to obtain a MyServiceNSW account, agree to its terms and conditions, link your MyServiceNSW account to WWCC, and hold a valid WWCC.

faqs.q: What must I ensure about my phone or device when using the WWCC?
faqs.a: You must ensure your device is working, sufficiently charged, and not damaged in a way that prevents the QR Code from being scanned.
